Spheres: Panoramas and Step Inside Worlds

Andy CASA, UCL East

Ok so its not city related but the movie below is worth a post as we have a bit of a 'thing' on visualising spheres, they are really useful for creating movies of panoramas.

Spheres from Regis Hervagault on Vimeo.


Therefore, you could put a panoramic image on each of the spheres and create a series of 'worlds within worlds'. For those who may of missed our posts a few years back on panoramic spheres, the movie below details the first concept:

Panoramic London Churches - HD from digitalurban on Vimeo.



Building on this further with 'step inside spheres':

Worlds within Worlds: Using Panoramas for Sense of Location and Place from digitalurban on Vimeo.



Its a theme we may return to as they are quick and easy to create yet we think provide an interesting way to visualise the urban environment (?)
